items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: it was put together by a man named Valdez

ctx.x: Miami for Cab, another Cotton Club show. Some other guys got an idea to put on a Cotton Club show like they did before because that one was such a hit, but it didn't last too long, although they were still using Benny Davis and the music.

And now in '59 they put a show together for Cab which he didn't know nothing about to go to South America, but I was the music director. And Cab calls me. He says, what is this show about? I said -- I tell him, well, it's going to be a pretty good show. So we'll have him, Leslie Scott and a lady named -- blues singer named Washington, had chorus girls and they had -- it was put together by a man named Valdez, and we were going down to the Copacabana in Rio de Janeiro.

So we got the show together, and we went down, and when we get there, we had the -- we didn't take a band. I only took a drummer, and we used the musicians down there. And we played in Rio for -- we were in Rio for about three or four weeks. Then we went to this -- not San Paolo. We did go to San Paolo. But we went to Santos.
